target: nyan thos chen po de dag dang / mchog tu dga' ba'i rgyal po dang / 'jam dpal la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' dpe med drug cu dang / byams pa dang / seng ge rab snang dang snang byed la thug pa'i bar la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad dang / phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / rgyal po'i btsun mo dpal bzangs dang / gser mchog snang dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/
